APP_ROOT.description: Root of the application; on a server, an absolute POSIX path.

DEPLOY_ROOT.description: The deployment folder the UI scans for stacks (default: APP_ROOT).

REFERENCE_ROOT.description: A known-good copy of the deployment folder that `compare` checks against.

COMPOSE_FILE.description: Compose file the compose verbs use by default.

ENV_FILE.description: Env file the compose verbs use by default.

WORK_DIR.description: Where generated files go; must stay gitignored.

COMPOSE_DEBUG_IMAGE.description: Generated compose override file naming the services that run a debug image.

REGISTRY_API.description: Registry v2 API base used to find base images; Artifactory: https://HOST/artifactory/api/docker/REPO-KEY.

REGISTRY_PREFIX.description: What precedes a repository name in an image reference pulled from that registry, e.g. HOST/REPO-KEY.

REGISTRY_USER.description: Registry user (basic auth). Keep it in globals.user.json.

REGISTRY_TOKEN.description: Registry password or token (Bearer when there is no user). Keep it in globals.user.json.

AZDO_PROJECT.description: The team project that holds the three repositories.

AZDO_PAT.description: Empty = sign in as the current Windows account. Kept in your own layer.

JFROG_USER.description: For exploring from this machine. The pipelines read JFROG_USER / JFROG_TOKEN from the variable group.

PIPELINE_POOL.description: Where both pipelines run. Needs dotnet; the product pipeline also needs docker with compose, bash and a browser.

PIPELINE_PLUGINS_REPO.description: The .NET plugin projects: built, tested, packed and pushed as NuGet.

PIPELINE_TESTS_REPO.description: The Selenium test projects run against the webportal.

PIPELINE_MAIN_BRANCH.description: Builds of this branch and of release/* run automatically.

PIPELINE_TAG_PREFIX.description: A git tag <prefix><version> marks a release: v gives v2.4.1. Empty = the tag is the version.

PIPELINE_PACKAGES.description: `;`-separated ids of the NuGet packages the product pipeline fetches. Empty = every package the plugins pipeline produced cannot be known; name them.

PIPELINE_CREDENTIALS_GROUP.description: A library variable group in the project; the token marked secret.

PIPELINE_NUGET_REPO_DEV.description: Artifactory repository key the plugins are pushed to for dev.

PIPELINE_DOCKER_REGISTRY_DEV.description: What precedes an image name when pushing for dev, e.g. HOST/docker-dev-local.

PIPELINE_DOCKER_REPO_DEV.description: Artifactory key behind the dev registry (for looking up tags).

PIPELINE_PLUGINS_DIR.description: The bind-mount source the plugin assemblies are unpacked into before the stack starts.

PIPELINE_BAKE_SERVICES.description: `;`-separated services whose bind-mounted config and plugins are copied into a final image.

PIPELINE_HEALTH_URL.description: Polled until it answers before the tests start, and handed to the tests as PORTAL_URL.

BUILD_PRODUCT_JSON.description: The product's data model file. Everything else flows from it.

BUILD_ENTITIES_PATH.description: Path inside product.json to the list of entities, e.g. model:entities. Empty = found automatically.

BUILD_TITLE.description: A short code for the product, about three letters: written to product.env, used as the prefix of container names.

BUILD_REALM.description: Empty = the product title in lower case.

BUILD_VERSION.description: Selects the images and the plugin packages. Empty = the version in use (versions tab).

BUILD_REGISTRY.description: What precedes image names, e.g. HOST/docker-dev-local.

BUILD_NUGET_REPO.description: Artifactory NuGet repository the plugin packages come from (with JFROG_URL / JFROG_USER / JFROG_TOKEN).

BUILD_TEMPLATE_DIR.description: docker-compose, .env, appsettings ... with {{PLACEHOLDERS}}, and template.json describing services, Keycloak and the test. Empty = the sample that ships with toolrunner.

BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Where the finished deployment is written. Existing files are overwritten; nothing is deleted.

BUILD_HOST.description: The name browsers and services use to reach this machine.

BUILD_PORT_BASE.description: {{PORT+0}}, {{PORT+1}} ... in the templates count from here.

BUILD_VALUES.description: `;`-separated NAME=value pairs for placeholders of your own.

BUILD_PRIVILEGE_FORMAT.description: {entity} is replaced by each entity name.

BUILD_PRIVILEGE_SEPARATOR.description: Joins the entities' privileges into the one string users carry.

BUILD_EXPECT.description: {entity} is replaced by each entity name; the test passes when all are on the page.

CONTAINER_ENGINE.description: The container CLI used wherever a tool runs docker: docker (default), podman, or a full path.

VERSION.description: The version builds and checkouts use. Unset: the version detected from the stack's image tags.

VERSION_PATTERN.description: Regex that finds the version inside an image tag.

VERSION_IGNORE.description: Regex for the parts of an image tag that describe the base image (alpine3.20 ...); never read as the application version.

VERSION_GIT_REFS.description: `;`-separated git ref templates tried in order for a version; {version} is replaced.

VERSION_LATEST_REFS.description: `;`-separated git refs that the version `latest` means.

VSDBG_DIR.description: Folder holding an unpacked vsdbg that debug images copy in (must match the image's libc: linux-x64 or linux-musl-x64).

VSDBG_URL.description: GetVsDbg.sh location used when VSDBG_DIR is not set (default https://aka.ms/getvsdbgsh).

ssh.description: Used with --host: connect to a Linux server over ssh (key auth only).

additionalProperties.description: One service. These keys are conventions used by args.json; add your own.

hostKey.description: Env-file key holding the host the consumer connects to.

debugHost.description: Host to point the consumer at while debugging.

consumer.description: Compose service that connects to this one.

logProbe.description: Log text that proves the consumer connected.
